title: Higher-order tangent and secant numbers, special-value integrals, and a common zero attractor
summary: We study two families of coefficients associated with powers of the tangent function and with products of the secant and tangent functions, and develop a unified treatment of the corresponding higher-order tangent and secant numbers. The first part establishes a common identity for even derivatives of $\tanh x$ and odd derivatives of $\operatorname{sech}x$. Combined with integral formulae for these derivatives, this yields finite power-integral representations for the normalized values $ζ(2n+1)$ and $β(2n)$ and naturally introduces two polynomial families $P_n$ and $Q_n$.
